LandingPage.HeroTitle: Keep track of your money and save for the future
LandingPage.HeroBody: Personal finance app help you to control your spending in one place. Track transactions, set budgets, and add to savings pots easily.
LandingPage.FeaturesSubtitle: Everything you need to manage your personal finances effectively.
LandingPage.FeatureTransactionsBody: Monitor all your income and expenses in one place. Get detailed insights into your spending patterns.
LandingPage.FeatureBudgetsBody: Set category-based budgets and watch your spending in real-time. Stay in control of your finances.
LandingPage.FeaturePotsBody: Create multiple savings goals and track your progress toward achieving them easily.
LandingPage.FeatureRecurringBody: Keep track of your recurring payments and never miss a bill deadline.
LandingPage.HowItWorksSubtitle: Get started in just four simple steps. Less than 5 minutes to set up.
LandingPage.Step1Body: Sign up with your email and secure password. Verify to get started.
LandingPage.Step2Body: Manually add transactions or import them. Categorize with ease.
LandingPage.Step3Body: Define spending limits for different categories based on goals.
LandingPage.Step4Body: Watch progress on dashboard, visualize trends, adjust as needed.
LandingPage.CtaBody: Join thousands of users who are already managing their finances smarter. Start your journey to financial freedom today.
LandingPage.FooterTagline: Your trusted personal finance management tool for a better financial future.

BudgetsPage.Title: Budgets
BudgetsPage.EmptyBody: Click <bold>''Add Budget''</bold> button at the corner of the page to create your first budget.
BudgetsPage.AddDescription: Choose a category to set a spending budget. These categories can help you monitor spending.
BudgetsPage.EditDescription: As your budgets change, feel free to update your spending limits.

PotsPage.Title: Pots
PotsPage.EmptyBody: Click <bold>''+Add New Pot''</bold> button at the corner of the page to create your first pot.
PotsPage.AddDescription: Create a pot to set savings targets. These can help keep you on track as you save for special purchases.
PotsPage.EditDescription: If your saving targets change, feel free to update your pots.
PotsPage.WithdrawDescription: Withdraw from your pot to put money back in your main balance. This will reduce the amount you have in this pot.
PotsPage.AddDescriptionMoney: Add money to your pot to keep it separate from your main balance. As soon as you add this money, it will be deducted from your current balance.

TransactionsPage.Title: Transactions
TransactionsPage.EmptyBody: Click <bold>''Add Transaction''</bold> button at the corner of the page to create it.
TransactionsPage.CreateDescription: Create new transaction for testing purposes.

RecurringPage.Title: Recurring Bills
RecurringPage.EmptyBody: Click <bold>''Add Recurring Bill''</bold> button at the corner of the page to create it.

LoginPage.SignInIntro: Sign in to your account to access your personal finance dashboard.
LoginPage.RegisterIntro: Create a new account to start managing your personal finances.
